pages.title: Halden Fen
pages.description: A fictional ceramics studio: stoneware made slowly and used daily.

sections.label: PLATE 01
sections.heading: Stoneware, made slowly and used daily.
sections.body: Halden Fen is a two-person studio. We throw, trim and glaze every piece by hand, in small firings.

sections.label: METHOD
sections.heading: One clay body, three glazes
sections.body: We keep the palette short on purpose. Fewer materials means we can learn each one properly and repair what we sell.

items.title: Everyday bowls
items.body: Three sizes, stacked and dishwasher safe.

items.title: Pouring jugs
items.body: A short spout that does not drip.

sections.label: NOTE
sections.heading: Repairs are part of the price.
sections.body: If a piece chips in normal use, bring it back. We will mend it or make it again.

pages.title: Works
pages.description: The current range from the fictional Halden Fen studio.

sections.label: PLATE 02
sections.heading: The current range
sections.body: Each firing produces about forty pieces. We list what is left after the studio shelf is full.

items.title: Ash white
items.body: A soft, matte white that shows the throwing lines.

items.title: Iron black
items.body: A satin black that breaks brown on the rims.

items.title: Fen green
items.body: A pale celadon that pools in the foot ring.

pages.title: Visit
pages.description: How to visit the fictional Halden Fen studio.

sections.label: HOURS
sections.heading: Visiting the studio
sections.body: The studio is open on Saturdays from ten until four. Other days by appointment.

sections.label: NOTE
sections.heading: Before you come
sections.body: The workshop floor is uneven and there are two steps at the door. Tell us if you need a hand and we will meet you outside.
